models.summary_html: The Pudu CC1 is a smart autonomous cleaning robot designed for commercial and industrial environments. It combines multiple cleaning functions into a single robot, making it ideal for offices, hotels, hospitals, shopping malls, and public facilities where consistent high-quality cleaning is critical.

features.name: Wet scrubbing and dry sweeping
features.html: Seamlessly performs wet scrubbing and dry sweeping within a single system, ensuring thorough removal of dust, spills, and stains across diverse floor surfaces.
AI-driven sensors automatically recognize different floor materials and adjust cleaning modes in real time to deliver safe, efficient, and optimized results.
Uses intelligent mapping and localization to navigate complex environments, ensuring complete coverage while smoothly transitioning between multiple floor types.

functions.title: Smart Dual-Mode Cleaning
functions.html: Automatically performs dry sweeping and wet mopping in a single cleaning cycle. The robot intelligently controls brush rotation, suction, and water flow to remove dust, debris, spills, and stains efficiently without manual intervention.

functions.title: Intelligent Surface Adaptation
functions.html: Detects different floor types and surface conditions in real time and dynamically adjusts cleaning pressure, speed, and moisture level. This ensures effective cleaning while protecting delicate surfaces and preventing over-wetting.

This autonomous 32‑inch floor scrubbing robot delivers deep cleaning for large spaces with a single pass.
